summary: Repository-level handoff validation now preserves immutable historical digests while checking current content only against the latest handoff occurrence for each canonical artifact path.
decisions: Canonical repository-relative artifact paths define supersession identity across runs.
Latest occurrence order is created_at, then handoff path, then artifact occurrence order so timestamp ties are deterministic and output evidence can supersede input evidence in one handoff.
Historical records retain structural, digest-format, and repository path-safety validation without mutable worktree digest comparison.
Direct validate_handoff_payload calls with target_repo retain strict current-file existence and SHA checks.

gate_results.command: uv run ruff check design_ontology_harness/agent_team.py tests/test_agent_team.py

risks: The shared repository validator can remain red until concurrently edited color artifacts receive their own newer completion handoff.
next_action: Team Lead reruns the shared agent-team validator after the Token Curator publishes the newer color-artifact handoff.
